opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice White would note probable jurisdiction and set these cases for oral argument. Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.
